zh: 每次最多发 2 件，所以至少要 ⌈n/2⌉ 次；同一仓库的商品不能配对，出现最多的仓库有 f 件，就至少要 f 次。
较大的那个下界总是可以达到：若某仓库占多数，就把它的商品逐个和其它仓库配对，剩下的单发；否则可以把商品配成不同仓库的对，最多剩一件单发。
统计各仓库编号的出现次数（排序后数连续段或用哈希表），取最大频次 f，输出 max(f, (n+1)/2)。
en: Each shipment carries at most 2 items, so at least ceil(n/2) shipments are needed; items from the same warehouse cannot be paired, so if the busiest warehouse has f items, at least f shipments are needed.

The larger of these lower bounds is always achievable: if one warehouse is a majority, pair its items one by one with items from other warehouses and ship the rest alone; otherwise the items can be paired across different warehouses with at most one left over.
Count the occurrences of each warehouse number (sort and count runs, or use a hash map), take the largest frequency f, and print max(f, (n+1)/2).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let f be the largest warehouse frequency; the answer is max(f, ceil(n/2)).

## Proof of correctness

At most 2 items per shipment gives the lower bound ceil(n/2), and the busiest warehouse can send only 1 item per shipment, giving the lower bound f. If one warehouse is a majority, pair it with the other warehouses and then ship the rest alone; otherwise items from different warehouses can be paired until at most 1 item remains, reaching the larger lower bound.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(n) space.
